BiblicalUsage: Jimla is Imla, an Israelite, the father of the prophet Micaiah. In 1 Kings 22:8, Micaiah the son of Imlah. The fuller story is told on the Imla, Father of Micaiah profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Imla shows me God keeps His promises across generations, even through flawed families.
